{"relevant": true, "severity": "warn", "message": "Removing CSRF from /admin in internal/admin/router.go is risky even behind a VPN: CSRF targets the admin's browser, which sits inside the VPN. A malicious page the admin visits can fire state-changing requests at the internal admin host, and the VPN doesn't stop that. Keep the CSRF middleware (it's cheap), or at minimum set session cookies to SameSite=Strict/Lax, require a custom header (e.g. X-Requested-With) or JSON content-type on mutating routes, and verify Origin/Host. Also make sure GET handlers under /admin never change state."}
